interpretations.explanation: Over Q[x], ascending-power quotient coefficients are ['-1', '1', '1'] and remainder coefficients are ['3']. The exact coefficient checks establish a = b*q + r. Rational-function and derivative interpretations require b(x) != 0. Coefficients are listed from the constant term upward. Euclidean division constructs q and r; differentiating a=bq+r gives a′=b′q+bq′+r′. The product and quotient derivative numerators agree by coefficient comparison. This finite result does not solve arbitrary calculus problems.
